integrity.verification: standalone standard-library Python script and reproducible finite checks

scientific_limitations: Requires an infinite right-sided marker word beginning with 1, positive nondecreasing unbounded gaps, and ordinary finite cyclic rotations.
Does not cover finite words, arbitrary leading zero prefixes, bounded or nonmonotone gap sequences, or all cyclic classes with just some rotations present.
Direct finite tests do not certify the infinite theorem; a written exact proof is provided.
Scientific originality remains subject to independent bibliographic and expert scrutiny.
title: Exact Lie complexity from plateaus of nondecreasing binary gaps
